Zoe (Marketing): quick ask — for launch collateral we need a rerun focused on tail cases + non-Latin languages. Can runtime run a stratified 10k sample with these explicit buckets: tokens <32, 32-256, 256-1024, >1024; languages: en, es, zh, ar, other. For each slice we want p50/p90/p99 latency, token cost, and failure rate. Run both quantized v2 and float32 variants. Need reproducible seeds and the exact run command. ETA Wed EOD?

Jordan (Runtime): can do. pls attach either the shard or the sample SQL. also: do we sample across warm vs cold? and which model checkpoints (exact names)?

Zoe (Marketing): attaching sample selector in thread (see SQL snippet below). prefer production routing distribution. include warm and cold — define warm as 3 warmup tokens. checkpoints: rwd-7b-v1 and rwd-7b-q4_0_v2. want outputs + raw traces.

Amy (Eng): fyi long-context >1024 uses different kernel path and will materially change perf/cost. recommend capping any extreme >4096 for this run to keep queue times reasonable. also provide prompt-length CDF so we can sanity-check bucket boundaries. suggested batch/concurrency baseline: concurrency=8, batch=32 but want run variants for 4/8/16.

Zoe (Marketing): noted — adding prompt CDF and will include concurrency variants 4/8/16. please preserve RNG seeds (we'll use seed=42) for reproducibility.

Sam (Ops): scheduling low-priority run on staging cluster tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. command i'll run (example):

```
./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-v1 --quant=none --samples=10000 \
  --buckets='tok:<32,32-256,256-1024,>1024' \
  --langs='en,es,zh,ar,other' \
  --warmup=3 --concurrency=8 --batch=32 --seed=42
./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 --quant=q4_0 --samples=10000 ...
```

I'll post job id once scheduled. :thumbsup:

runbot: Job scheduled -> job-20260303-008. ETA ~6h. logs: https://ci/internal/job-20260303-008/logs

Jordan (Runtime): quick q — how do we tag individual requests as warm vs cold in the payloads? header `X-Warmup=1` or metadata field `warmup_tokens`? need consistent tagging so we can compute cold p99 separately.

Zoe (Marketing): use header `X-Path:prefetch=warm` (we'll bake that into the sample payloads). also dropping a small tarball of multi-turn edgecases to /mnt/marketing/edgecases.tar.gz (long zh threads, arabic right-to-left, code-mix examples).

Sam (Ops): job job-20260303-008 finished. quick summary: ran both variants, 10k samples each. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4784001234/. initial notes: quantized v2 showed ~12% lower throughput on >1024 bucket, failure rate overall 0.3% (most failures on zh long sequences). attached CSVs: per-slice p50/p90/p99 + token-costs. full post-run report coming in next message.
